fix.migration: supabase/migrations/20261016150000_workspace_item_visibility.sql — adds workspace_items.visibility ('private'|'team'), default 'team'. fix.rlsChange: The business_id-is-not-null branch of the read/update/delete policies now additionally requires (visibility='team' OR owner_id=auth.uid()) — the owner always keeps access to their own item regardless of visibility; other active members only when visibility='team'. fix.ownershipGuardExtension: Extended the existing guard_workspace_item_identity trigger (20261014043916) — not a new mechanism — to also block a non-owner from changing visibility, closing a related gap found while designing the fix: without this, any team member could flip someone else's item to 'team' (exposing it) or to 'private' (locking the real owner's team out of something previously shared).

realBugFoundAndFixedInTheSameFile.bug: lib/work/items.ts's createWorkItemSchema had .default(...) on status/body directly on fields shared with updateWorkItemSchema via .partial(). zod's .default() survives .partial() — an omitted key still resolves to the default during parsing, not to undefined. Confirmed live and reproduced before fixing: app/components/library/library-documents-panel.tsx's autosave PATCHes only {id, body, expectedUpdatedAt}; parsed.data.status would still be 'open' even though the caller never sent it, and the route's `if (parsed.data.status !== undefined) patch.status = ...` guard would then silently reset a 'done'/'draft' document's status back to 'open' on every single autosave.
realBugFoundAndFixedInTheSameFile.whyFixedHere: Discovered while adding the new visibility field to this exact shared schema — adding it the same (defaulted) way would have reproduced the identical defect for the new field, and leaving the pre-existing status/body instances unfixed after finding them would be 'moving past a broken dependency.'
realBugFoundAndFixedInTheSameFile.fix: Restructured lib/work/items.ts: a shared workItemFields object with NO defaults, used directly (via .partial()) for updateWorkItemSchema; createWorkItemSchema extends it with defaults applied only on the fields that need them for creation. Verified the exact failure and the exact fix with a standalone reproduction (not just inferred) before and after.
realBugFoundAndFixedInTheSameFile.regressionTest: tests/work/items-route.test.ts: new case sends exactly the real autosave shape ({id, body, expectedUpdatedAt}) and asserts the resulting database patch has neither 'status' nor 'visibility' keys.
